cv.name: Itziar Sarasola
cv.headline: Marketing Manager | B2B Industrial | Brand & Product Marketing
cv.summary: Marketing manager with ten years in B2B industrial companies in the Basque Country. I have led both brand and demand generation and the product marketing side, from positioning and launches to sales enablement for distributors in 30 countries.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Lead a marketing team of six and a €1.6M budget covering brand, digital and trade shows
Repositioned the brand for the hydrogen and energy transition markets
Launched three product lines with positioning, pricing input and distributor training
Marketing-sourced pipeline grew from €8M to €14M in three years

experience.title: Product Marketing Specialist
bullets: Wrote value propositions, datasheets and competitive battlecards for motion control products
Coordinated product launches with R&D and sales in Europe and Latin America

experience.title: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Organised trade fair participation and managed the corporate website
